title: Patch v0.2.0: Classic and Classic+
notes: Two new sets, Classic (90 cards) and Classic+ (78 cards and 38 tokens), with the keywords Animated, Activate, Brittle, Degrade and Upgrade. Core: Hit Job costs (3); Flood, Collateral Damage, Big Felinor, Snom Bunny Mind Control and Twisting Nether cost (4); Masochism Mask costs (1); new text for Hinder, Carnivorous Cube, KY's Math Equation, Prem Panther, Sheepish, Bear Honeypot and Call to Chaos's Radiant face; every card writes a specific cost as "(N) Cost"; every card records its lines of code.
